seo.title: Meds Easy — Medication Reminder for iOS
seo.description: Never miss a dose. A simple, private medication tracker with smart reminders, refill tracking, and adherence stats. No cloud, no account required.

hero.label: MEDICATION REMINDERS
hero.title: Never miss a dose.
text: A simple, private medication tracker that helps you stay on schedule. Smart reminders, refill alerts, and adherence insights — all on your device.

screenshots.alt: Meds Easy — Never Miss a Dose
screenshots.label: Never Miss a Dose

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need to stay on track.

items.title: Medication Schedules
items.text: Set up complex schedules with ease. Daily, weekly, every other day, or custom intervals — the app adapts to your prescriptions.

items.title: Smart Reminders
items.text: Timely notifications that actually help. Snooze if you need a few minutes, or mark as taken right from the notification.

items.title: Refill Tracking
items.text: Know when you're running low. Track your supply and get alerts before you run out so you never scramble for refills.

items.title: Adherence Stats
items.text: See your medication history at a glance. Track your consistency over time and celebrate your streaks.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: Your medication data stays on your device. No accounts, no cloud sync, no data collection. Your health information is yours alone.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Log doses from your wrist. Quick, convenient, and always with you when it's time to take your medication.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your meds. Your data.
text: Medication data is deeply personal. That's why Meds Easy stores everything locally on your device. No HealthKit. No cloud. No analytics. No exceptions.

cta.title: Stay on schedule.
cta.text: Coming soon to the App Store. No account required.
